path.style: fill: var(--fig-navy); opacity: 0.16; stroke: var(--fig-navy); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: miter
fill: var(--fig-warn); opacity: 0.16; stroke: var(--fig-warn); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: miter
fill: var(--fig-accent); opacity: 0.16; stroke: var(--fig-accent); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: miter
fill: none; stroke: var(--fig-grid); stroke-width: 0.7; stroke-linecap: round

text.style: fill: var(--fig-ink); font: 7.5px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
fill: var(--fig-ink); font: 7.5px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
fill: var(--fig-navy); font: 7.5px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace; text-anchor: middle
fill: var(--fig-ink); font: 8.5px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
fill: var(--fig-ink); font: 8.5px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
fill: var(--fig-warn); font: 7.5px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace; text-anchor: middle
fill: var(--fig-ink); font: 8.5px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
fill: var(--fig-ink); font: 8.5px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
fill: var(--fig-accent); font: 7.5px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace; text-anchor: middle
